title: BridgeFromExtension

protocolVersion.description: The bridge protocol version the extension speaks: served when it is the environment's or the one before.

extensionVersion.description: The extension's version: the harness version it was built with.

name.description: The name the Chrome pairs as (Work, Personal), as the person typed it; the environment trims and cleans it.

oneOf.description: announce: an extension that holds no credential opens its socket with its versions and the name it would pair as.

code.description: The pairing code as the person typed it; the environment reads it in its canonical form.

name.description: The name the Chrome pairs as (Work, Personal), as the person typed it; the environment trims and cleans it.

oneOf.description: pair: the code the person typed, and the name, on the announced socket.

protocolVersion.description: The bridge protocol version the extension speaks: served when it is the environment's or the one before.

extensionVersion.description: The extension's version: the harness version it was built with.

environmentId.description: The environment the extension paired with.

chromeId.description: A paired Chrome's id: a UUID its environment mints when it pairs.

name.description: The name the Chrome paired as; a later hello never renames it.

oneOf.description: hello: a paired extension opens its socket with its versions, the environment it paired with and its Chrome's id.

mac.description: HMAC-SHA256 of the challenge's nonce as sent (its UTF-8 bytes), keyed by the secret's 32 bytes, in lowercase hex.

oneOf.description: proof: the answer to a challenge, which proves the secret without sending it.

id.description: The call's id, chosen by the environment and echoed by its result.

value.description: The verb's value, as PAGE_VERB_SCHEMAS gives it.

notice.description: Something true of the answer that is not part of it: a wait clamped, a buffer that dropped its oldest entries.

reason.description: The sentence the model reads: what went wrong and what it can do instead.

denylist.description: The denylist entry that refused an address a frame reached, and which frame.

frame.description: top-level: a navigation of the page, held at about:blank and put to the person; sub-frame: a frame of the page, which refuses the page whole.

section.description: A section of the denylist: browserDomains (where a browser verb may not go unasked), paths (files and directories), commandPatterns (shell command lines), or hosts (what a command, a fetch, a search or one of the harness's own tools may not reach unasked).

id.description: The entry's id, unique in its section: a preset's is the same on every environment.

pattern.description: The pattern, in its section's grammar.

note.description: Why the entry is there, for people; empty for none.

preset.description: Whether it came from the presets (seeded on first start, or restored); an edited preset keeps it.

enabled.description: Whether it matches: a disabled entry never does.

entry.description: One entry of the denylist: its id, pattern, note, whether it is a preset, and whether it is enabled.

matched.description: What the call gave that matched it: a path, a command line, an address.

match.description: One denylist entry a call matched: the section, the entry, and what matched it.

anyOf.description: A refusal: a sentence the model can act on, never an exception, with the denylist's match when the browser section refused an address.

result.description: A verb's answer: its value, or a refusal.

oneOf.description: result: a verb's answer, its value or a refusal, for the call with this id.
ping: either side, to keep the socket and the extension's worker alive.
pong: the answer to a ping.

reason.description: Why, as a sentence for a person.

oneOf.description: refused: either side, the socket is refused or ending, and why.

description: A message the extension sends, told apart by its type.
